Question
========
Which of the following statements describe strong sustainability?
(More than one statement may be correct.)

Answerlist
----------
* Natural capital and human-made capital complement each other and humans cannot survive without both.
* The sixth wave of extinctions is considered to be the most important sustainability problem.
* Environmental problems are resolved through innovative energy technologies.
* Preserving critical natural capital from one generation to the next is required.
* An increase to the total amount of all forms of capital is called for.
* Nature is viewed as a form of capital that contributes to the well-being of people in an invaluable way.


Solution
========
Strong sustainability emphasizes the essential and non-substitutable role of natural capital for human survival and well-being. It requires the preservation of critical natural capital across generations and recognizes that nature provides indispensable contributions to human well-being that cannot be fully replaced by human-made capital or technological innovation.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* True
* False
* True
